title: : LOVE LIFTS
verse: “Bear ye one another's burdens.” (KJV) Gal 6:2
body: : LOVE LIFTS “Bear ye one another's burdens.” (KJV) Gal 6:2 An American missionary was once walking down the streets of a Chinese city where he saw some boys carrying smaller children upon their backs and still playing their games. "It is too bad," the missionary said to one little fellow, "that you have to carry such a heavy burden!" "He is no burden," came the quick reply; "He is my brother." When the missionary returned home he said to his family, "A little Chinese boy has taught me the fullest meaning of the words, 'Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.' " He said, "If a little Chinese boy can carry and care for his brother and refuse to consider him a burden, surely we ought not to think it a burden to carry our brother, the weak and the needy ones, who look to us for help. Let us rejoice as we carry one, and say, by our actions, 'He is no burden; he is my brother.'" This is the pragmatic praxis of love. Make a choice to be loving and lovely. Be a love practitioner. Be a love demonstrator. Be a love preacher. Besides, your love must be unalloyed, uncontaminated and unadulterated, 1John 4:7.
prayer: Ask God for inner strength to love supremely without counting it.

title: : BEAR ONE ANOTHER’S BURDENS
verse: might” (KJV) Deut 6:5
body: : BEAR ONE ANOTHER’S BURDENS “And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might” (KJV) Deut 6:5 Loving God with your entire being - is a full, total and all-inclusive love. That's what God requires. By loving God, we’re not doing God a favour; we’re only fulfilling our divine mandate. We’re to love God because He is our God and much more, He is our Creator – He created us for His purpose. God must take the first priority - first in all we do. We must give Him all our heart to adore, worship and glorify Him. We are to love Him without reservation with all we have got - be it our materials, finances, prestige, influence and achievements. Let us all awake to this realm of love aflame for our God who has the only begotten SON and freely gave Him to us. Love-drive to please God is not something extraordinary - it’s fundamental to Christian living. It is not something outrageous, but the main course.
prayer: Lord, I give You first place in my heart and life. I ask that You set my heart aflame to fulfil Your eternal purpose. Cause the flaming fire of the Spirit Divine to quicken me and radiate Your love wherever I go in Jesus name, Amen.

title: : LOVE AFLAME FOR GOD
verse: according as I have loved you” (KJV) John 15:12
body: : LOVE AFLAME FOR GOD “This is my command, that ye love one another, according as I have loved you” (KJV) John 15:12 Real love absorbs the spots in the lives of others, making them feel the warmth of love emanating out of our own hearts towards them. Loving like Jesus is that simple! Loving like Christ begins with willingness, continues with willingness and is made perfect in willingness. Don't forget, Where there is a will; there is a way. Be willing to love like Christ. Back it up with sacrifice. As we love like Jesus, we are loved by Jesus. He blesses us for being a blessing. He keeps us alive so as to reflect and radiate more of His love. Love all - sinners and saints alike. Share the love of Christ with sinners by telling them Jesus loves and saves. Share the love of Christ with saints by your positive impact on them. Love like Christ and never stop loving in spite of ridicule, derision or persecution. Jesus, our perfect model of love faced all of these yet, He never stopped loving.
confession: I will love (4 times), I'll love Jesus' people, I'll love everybody. Jesus taught me to love. I will love. I am making a commitment to love like Jesus - everyday, everywhere and in every occasion - I receive a sacrificial heart!

title: : LOVING EVEN LIKE CHRIST
verse: hath given himself for us.” (KJV) Eph 5:1-2
body: : LOVING EVEN LIKE CHRIST “. walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us.” (KJV) Eph 5:1-2 A boy once found a terrapin. When he began to examine it, the terrapin pulled in its head and closed its shell like a vice. This greatly got the boy annoyed and he picked up something to get it opened by force. His uncle saw this and said: "No, that is not the way! You may kill it, but you will not get it open." The uncle then decided to take the terrapin into the house and set it on the hearth. It never took time before it got warmth. It was then the terrapin pushed out its head, its feet, and began crawling. “Terrapins are like that," the uncle said, "and people, too. You cannot force them into anything. But if you first warm them up with some real love, more than likely they will do what you want them to do." “. ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another” (KJV) 1Thes 4:9. Read Eph 5:1-2. Some may walk in hatred while some walk in bitterness, you walk in the brightness of love. Some may be hostile, but you choose to be friendly. While some are malicious and malignant, you can be magnanimous.
prayer: Ask God for spiritual strength and stamina to walk and keep walking in true love - everyday.

title: : W ALKING IN LOVE
verse: mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing”
body: : W ALKING IN LOVE “And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing” (KJV) 1 Cor 13:2 Of the nine gifts of the Spirit listed in 1 Cor 12:8-10, prophecy is given special prominence by Apostle Paul, 1 Cor 14:1. As good as the gifts of prophecy, understanding mysteries, knowledge and faith are, they can’t be compared with charity - the crown of perfection. Life is enriched, deepened, beautified and strengthened by love. Without love, live would appear dull and dark. Life is simply made exciting where love is existing. To promote real life, promote true love. Love keeps you on top and establishes you on the Rock – Jesus! It is more blessed to love than to be loved. The joy of it all is that you are loved by the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit. Great is the joy of loving. Love is the beginning and the end of God's will. We’re all called, commanded and commissioned to love and we can't do otherwise.
prayer: Dear Jesus, I am ready to live by Your Word by reaching out to sinners with the gospel of love and to the saints with the seeds of love, Amen.

title: : BEYOND THE GIFT OF PROPHECY
verse: three; but the greatest of these is charity” (KJV)
body: : BEYOND THE GIFT OF PROPHECY “And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity” (KJV) 1Corinthians 13:13 Faith is the spiritual currency with which we place demand on spiritual blessings. With hope, we view eternal blessedness. But, with charity, we show forth the virtues of the grace which we receive by faith in living a life in accordance to God’s perfect will. Faith takes us to the realm of entitlement; hope takes us to the realm of anticipation; but by love we are certified to enjoy heaven. Faith lays the foundation for dynamic Christian life; hope raises the superstructure; love finishes and perfects our building. Faith and hope continue only through life; love continues throughout eternity. “All the special gifts and powers from God will someday come to an end, but love goes on forever. Someday prophecy and speaking in unknown languages and special knowledgethese gifts will disappear” (TLB)1 Cor 13:8. Love exerts a greater influence - it overcomes more evils. It is the force that binds the universe in harmony; that unites God to His creatures, and the creatures to their God.
prayer: Spend quality time in prayers as led.

title: : THESE THREE
verse: love dwelleth in God.” (KJV) 1John 4:16
body: : THESE THREE “And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God.” (KJV) 1John 4:16 How sweet and refreshing to know that God cares! He has a deep-seated, heart-felt concern for every ramification of your life. “He will not suffer [my] foot to be moved: he that keepeth [me] will not slumber. Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep. The LORD is [my] keeper: the LORD is [my] shade upon [my] right hand. The sun shall not smite [me] by day, nor the moon by night. The LORD shall preserve [me] from all evil: he shall preserve [my] soul. The LORD shall preserve [my] going out and [my] coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore” (KJV) Ps 121:3-8. Brood over these promises of divine help in your heart: Proverbs 3: 23, how encouraging - thy foot shall not stumble, Psalms 91:11-12, here is a word for pregnant women, Isa 27: 3.
confession: Standing on the promises of God for my life, I declare and decree, the sun shall not smite me by day, nor the moon by night. The LORD shall preserve me from all evil: he shall preserve my soul. The LORD shall preserve my going out and my coming in from this time forth.

title: : HE CARES!
verse: and were scattered abroad.” (KJV) Matt 9:36
body: : HE CARES! “But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad.” (KJV) Matt 9:36 Jesus' bowels of compassion was moved at the sight of the weak, wobbly and woozy multitudes. Each moment you see, do you see beyond the present to the nearest future of the lost around you? When Jesus saw, He saw the helplessness and hopelessness of the lost. He saw they were desperately in need of the gospel. You need Christ-kind of passion that originates from affectionate heart at seeing the miseries of sinners, Matt 9:36-38. You’re the one to take the saving gospel of Christ to them right where they are. This generation of saints will be held responsible if this generation of sinners is lost. We can't afford to be passive about this Godordained task of leading men to life and light. We must all be practically involved in reaching the lost. Go, declare His love to the lost. Passionately compel them to surrender their lives to Jesus, Rev 21:8. Go rescue the perishing!
prayer: 1. Ask God for blazing passion for soul winning 2. Tell Him you will be more strategic in the work. [Hymn: Must I Go, and Empty-Handed?]

title: : YOUR LOVE FOR THE LOST
verse: should not perish, but have everlasting life.” (KJV)
body: : YOUR LOVE FOR THE LOST “For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.” (KJV) John 3:16 God, through the impulse of His love, provided an eternal rescue through His only begotten Son to save the world in its condemned condition. To save the world, what He did was to give all He had – Jesus! What a message! You always have something to give to show you love. Heaven will not ask what is beyond man. Love begins from the heart. If you must love like God, pray for a deepseated, heart-felt love of God to permeate your heart. There is no sweeter experience than a heart full of and filled with God and His kind of love. You see, God had every reason to hate the world. He could wipe billions of lives out in a twinkling of an eye without costing Him anything. But He rather decided to love the world even while the world is still wilfully wallowing in wickedness. He worked out a plan of redemption instead of destruction, Rom 5:6.
prayer: Father, I've come to understand that You are indeed Love Personified, I will love and herald Your love to a dying world in Jesus' name, Amen.

title: : THE MAGNANIMITY OF GOD
verse: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death”
body: : THE MAGNANIMITY OF GOD “. when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death” (KJV) Jam 1: 15 Love becomes a sin when lust is involved. You must avoid evil and carnal lust. As good thoughts culminate in good actions and afterwards in life eternal, so also, evil thoughts culminate in evil actions and afterwards in death eternal. Flee - take off, run off and head off - all evil thought, concupiscence, immorality, sexual perversion, lewdness and filthiness, Matt 5: 28. God hates defilement. And so, we must keep our life and heart away from it. Be it in form of pornography, dirty film or offensive dress. Our body is the temple of the living God and we can't afford to defile God's temple. Keep yourself away from objects and friends that lead you in the path of lust, Pro 6:25. Decide never to allow lust in your heart. You can't afford to be lost due to lust. You can remain saintly – sparkling, spotless and spick-and-spin - in this sullied and stained society! Fill your heart with His Word and lust will not have a place in you.
prayer: Come against every root of lust in your heart 2. Take a hold of Rom 6:14 - establish your dominion over the spirit of lust. 3. Pray for others.

title: 1: LOVE WITHOUT LUST
verse: harmony]” (AMP) Col 3:14
body: 1: LOVE WITHOUT LUST “And above all these [put on] love and enfold yourselves with the bond of perfectness [which binds everything together completely in ideal harmony]” (AMP) Col 3:14 If we must be made complete in Christ, it becomes a necessity to wear love like garment. Nothing can favourably replace loveliness of love. No power of faith or wonderful gifts of the Spirit would do. A life without love is like a car without fuel - it goes nowhere. Some years back, Dr. Karl Menninger, a practicing doctor and psychologist, was trying to get the cause of many of his patients' diseases. One day, he decided to call his clinical staff and proceeded to unfold a plan for developing, in his clinic, an atmosphere of creative love. At the end of six months, the time spent by patients in the clinic was cut in half. Love is more than a garment; it's your armour and shield. Without love, life is naked and exposed to all sort of assault. By operating in love, you'll be operating in the light and no power of darkness will be able to conquer you.
prayer: Father, having got the big picture of the loveliness of love, I devote my life-time, by Your grace, to living in real love in Jesus' name, Amen.

title: : CREA TING AN ATMOSPHERE OF LOVE
verse: “Let brotherly love continue” (KJV) Hebrews 13:1
body: : CREA TING AN ATMOSPHERE OF LOVE “Let brotherly love continue” (KJV) Hebrews 13:1 By God's standard, we are instructed to maintain uninterrupted and unrelenting flow of love among the brethren. Strife must not be allowed to break the cord of brotherly love. Maintain peace - everywhere, every time - in spite of misunderstanding and misinterpretation. With true brotherly love - I tell you - you enjoy true brotherly blessings. “LET LOVE for your fellow believers continue and be a fixed practice with you [never let it fail]” (Amp). Make love a permanent practice - unchanging and unending - even in the midst of disagreement. Never allow love to fail. Our love must not be in pretence, but in practice. Love is proactive and not just empty promises of I love you. Our brotherly love must not be allowed to decline, dwindle nor die away, concerted effort is needed to sustain it among brethren, Rom 12:10. Outdo - outshine, outclass - one another in showing honour. Be eager to show warm respect.
prayer: Almighty God, thank You for another fresh insight received from Your Word, I will always let love win in the midst of hatred. I will not be overcome by evil – anywhere in Jesus' name, Amen.

title: : PROMOTING BROTHERL Y LOVE
verse: him again” (KJV) Pro 19:17
body: : PROMOTING BROTHERL Y LOVE “He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again” (KJV) Pro 19:17 Here is God's express command, “If there be among you a poor man. and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need, in that which he wanteth” (KJV) Deut 15:7-8. Our daily life should be a life of liberality. He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse” (KJV) Pro 28:27. It is impossible to be a giver and be a loser. God is a faithful Rewarder! “And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple. he shall in no wise lose his reward” (KJV) Math10:42. Hear this, “. And if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness be as the noonday” See our text in TLB, “When you help the poor you are lending to the Lord-and he pays wonderful interest on your loan!” Brood over the truth in Isa 58:7-10.
confession: I’ll live a life of liberality - touching and transforming countless lives everywhere I go. His abounding grace is multiplied unto me in the name of the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit.

title: : THE LOVELINESS OF LIBERALITY
verse: not in him” (NKJV) 1 John 2:15
body: : THE LOVELINESS OF LIBERALITY “Do not love the world or the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him” (NKJV) 1 John 2:15 You can't claim to love the Word and love the world. As children of God, worldly pleasures and passions have to be consciously avoided. We’re commanded not to love the systems of this world, James 4:4. The more of the love of the world develops in your heart, the more the love of God in your heart declines and decays. “And do not follow the customs of the present age, but be transformed by the entire renewal of your minds, so that you may learn by experience what God's will is.” (WNT) Rom 12:2. To withstand this evil wind of worldly allurements, hear what the Psalmist says, “I have laid up thy word in my heart, that I might not sin against thee” (RSV) Ps 119:11. Let His Word direct and dictate your way of life. I leave you with this counsel, Col 3:1-2.
prayer: Dear Lord, I declare Your Lordship over my spirit, soul and body. The Word of God will always prevail in my life. I choose not to live in conformity to the worldly pleasures, passions and profits. I will not let God down in Jesus precious name, Amen. [Hymn: Trust and Obey]

title: : LOVE NOT THE WORLD
verse: because it knew him not” (KJV) 1 John 3:1
body: : LOVE NOT THE WORLD “Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not” (KJV) 1 John 3:1 We are made partakers of His divine nature by the love that the Father has lavished on us. We who are guilt-ridden and blameworthy; are made the sons and daughters of God by His surpassing gracious adoption. By our spiritual adoption into God's regal and noble family, we can now boldly address God as our Father, much more, as our Friend and Confidant. Like depressed, miserable and hopeless orphans, we are provided with a home where care and comfort are real and natural. With this extraordinary love of the Father, we ought to make a conscious effort to love and live for Him who loves us with the love that money and material things can't acquire. Our Saviour became a servant that we slaves might be made sons and daughters of God, John 1:12.
prayer: Dear Lord, I sincerely appreciate the kind and degree of Your love that is bestowed upon me. I am deeply grateful for Your love towards my redemption. I will forever love and live for You in Jesus' name, Amen. [Hymn: Jesus Loves Even Me]

title: : WE ARE MADE P ARTAKERS OF HIS DIVINE NA TURE
verse: not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up”
body: : WE ARE MADE P ARTAKERS OF HIS DIVINE NA TURE “Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up” (KJV) 1 Cor 13:4 If you must be a truly great man, you must be a truly loving man. First of all, true love suffers long - patiently enduring in the midst of provocations and persecution without losing strength of mind. True love is kind - gracious and generous response to the needs of others - so thoughtful, and considerate. Kind love is tender and temperate in all things not harsh and unnecessarily hard, always and ever ready to show concern and commiseration. This is the realm God expects from us all. True love rejoices at the progress, promotion and divine providence of others. Above all, true love is none of self and all of Christ. It does not boast nor become pompous because of his achievements. It does not desire to be noticed but rather desires that God takes all glory You can prove to the world around by your life of humility that Christ's love dwells in you.
confession: I will demonstrate true love of Christ. Endurance, tenderness, temperance and humility shall characterized my lifestyle both in practice and principle by the help of the Holy Spirit.

title: : MARK OF TRUE LOVE
verse: own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil” (KJV)
body: : MARK OF TRUE LOVE “Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil” (KJV) 1 Cor 13:5 TBCL says, “Doesn't force itself on others, Isn't always "me first," Doesn't fly off the handle, Doesn't keep score of the sins of others.” True love strictly promotes the law of decency and orderliness everywhere, every time and uses the Word of God as a standard of living. True love is not offensive, vulgar and boorish. True love does not demand its own way - It does not seek its own best solely; it does not seek its own convenience at the expense of others. Amplified says, “It is not conceited (arrogant and inflated with pride); it is not rude (unmannerly) and does not act unbecomingly. Love (God's love in us) does not insist on its own rights or its own way, for it is not selfseeking; it is not touchy or fretful or resentful; it takes no account of the evil done to it [it pays no attention to a suffered wrong].” Read Phil 2:4. True love is not touchy and unnecessarily too tough. True love does not seek evil against anyone.
confession: I choose never to be offensive - never to be touchy but rather to be eventempered with all sense of temperance.

title: : MARK OF TRUE LOVE
verse: “Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth”
body: : MARK OF TRUE LOVE “Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth” (KJV) 1 Cor 13:6 True love does not take delight in the downfall or demise of others nor in the fall or failure of others. The Amplified says, “It does not rejoice at injustice and unrighteousness, but rejoices when right and truth prevail.” It does not find pleasure in hearing that others have gone into error or committed sin. True love will not desire his persecutor to die. When something evil has befallen an enemy, it’s in human nature to be pleased and feel contented, but you don't allow human nature to have a rule over you, the nature of God is planted in you. True love rejoices at seeing offenders and sinners come to repentance. True love rejoices when God is pleased and His kingdom on earth advances. The Bible clearly states that true love rejoices in the truth. How wonderful! Seek to know more about the truth. Protect the truth. Proclaim and promote the truth of the Word of God. This is the mark of true love. Let us join hands to advance God's course of love on earth.
confession: Never to delight myself in the downfall or demise of others. I’ll rejoice in the truth and live by the truth of Your love.

title: : MARK OF TRUE LOVE
verse: some have entertained angels unawares” (KJV)
body: : MARK OF TRUE LOVE “Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares” (KJV) Heb 13:2 Generosity generates generosity. Goodness begets goodness. If you must be favoured, you must be friendly. If you must be helped, you must be hospitable. There is greatness in every goodness. If you desire to be great, desire to be good. Being truly great begins with being truly generous. “. I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me. Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink? When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee? Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee? And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me” (KJV) Mat 25:34-40.
confession: By a resolute determination, I commit myself to becoming a lover of hospitality.

title: : LOVE AND HOSPIT ALITY
verse: is hypocrisy” (KJV) Luke 12:1
body: : LOVE AND HOSPIT ALITY “. Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy” (KJV) Luke 12:1 The Greek word for hypocrisy as used in our text is hupokrisis meaning acting under a feigned part or practise deceit or dissimulation. Jesus cautioned the people against the leaven of the Pharisees. In all our dealings, we must consciously and carefully avoid hypocritical kind of love. Leaven or yeast mixed in flour may not be known until it produces its effects. Like yeast makes flour swell and puff up, so will hypocrisy do - it puffs a man up and fills him will pride and arrogance. When Jesus warned the people to beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, He wanted them to avoid the spirit at work in them. If our love must be approved by God, our love have to be without duplicity, mendacity and disingenuousness. Our love have to be pure and uncontaminated, Matt 6:2, 5, 16. This is our Lord's direct command. Our practices must be without hypocrisy.
prayer: Father, I bow to Your Word and Way. I will, by Your grace, live a life without hypocrisy in Jesus precious name, Amen. Pray with Special Breakthrough Prayers and spend quality time in the place of prayer.

title: : LOVE WITHOUT HYPOCRISY
verse: bear sin on account of him” (DT) Lev 19:17
body: : LOVE WITHOUT HYPOCRISY “Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thy heart; thou shalt earnestly rebuke thy neighbour, lest thou bear sin on account of him” (DT) Lev 19:17 “Thou shalt not hate.” Very clear and plain! Hatred, no matter your reason and excuse, is not permitted by God. It's simply forbidden. Hatred is detrimental, damaging and destructive to your destiny. A life of hatred is harmful to your health. Hatred hangs heaviness on the heart – with a heavy heart; you end up having a heavy day. The Bible has not left us in darkness as to how to handle offences and trespasses. “Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother” Matt 18:15. It’s only when the offender fails to settle with you that you now move to verses 16 and 17 action plan, The key to a peaceful heart, peaceful home, peaceful habitation is in peaceful settlement. Don't wait until the offender comes for settlement – you go and be reconciled with him. God delights in an atmosphere of affability.
confession: I renown every form of hatred. I hereby declare my dominion over hatred. I lose its grip over my life – I shall live above hatred.

title: : WHEN HA TRED COME KNOCK AT THE DOOR
verse: defiled” (KJV) Heb 12:15
body: : WHEN HA TRED COME KNOCK AT THE DOOR “Looking diligently. lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled” (KJV) Heb 12:15 If there is anything you must avoid like plague, it's the root of bitterness. Bitterness bites and lives you defenseless and vulnerable. Bitterness is a troubler and defiler. You can't be bitter and claim to be better. The word bitter comes from pikria meaning poison. That's what exactly bitterness is – it's a poison – it poisons your heart against your offender and against yourself. You hardly make a better progress when in bitterness. “. Keep a sharp eye out for weeds of bitter discontent. A thistle or two gone to seed can ruin a whole garden in no time” (TBCL). When bitterness come knock at the door of my heart, what do I do? Alright, three things to be done: the first, the second and the third, forget the offence and forgive the offender. You don't need to brood over the matter, no matter the magnitude of the offence, go right ahead to forgive. Nothing is as important as your peace. Don't tell me, you can't forgive. Release him and experience real JOY.
confession: I refuse to be embittered. Bitterness shall not have dominion over me. I release all.

title: : AVOIDING ROOT OF BITTERNESS
verse: lay down his life for his friends” (KJV) John 15:13
body: : AVOIDING ROOT OF BITTERNESS “Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends” (KJV) John 15:13 As I brood over the sacrifice of Jesus to redeem us from eternal damnation, I discover that there is no price too great to pay, no effort too profound to make for the sake of erring ones. Jesus gave all He had – He gave His precious life. What a sacrifice! What a love! Jesus gave His life not because He didn't need it, He gave it because He unconditionally loved us. An historic account had it that when Cyrus had made war on Tigranes and had taken his wife and son as prisoners. Cyrus asked Tigranes, how much would you give as a ransom to have your wife again? Tigranes answered and said, I will indeed, O Cyrus, ransom her even with MY LIFE that she may be free from slavery. Jesus poured out His own precious blood not for His friends but for His enemies, mischievous and malicious enemies. Jesus went through the most excruciating, protracted and heartbreaking torment for a thoughtless, heedless and reckless generation. Give the dire world what it really needs – JESUS' LOVE
prayer: Jesus, I give You my heart, fill it up with Your love. And Lead me into a new realm of love.

title: : SO SACRIFICIAL, SO AMAZING
verse: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye” (KJV)
body: : SO SACRIFICIAL, SO AMAZING “Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye” (KJV) Col 3:13 If you can always forbear and forgive you can always forge ahead! It takes forbearance to move forward. Without forbearance, forgiveness and fellowship will be a mere flight of fancy – unrealisable and unfeasible, Eph 4:2. In every matter of misunderstanding, excuse the offender in your heart – never allow anything to affect your relationship with your God. Your relationship with God is much more important than any thing. “And when ye stand praying, forgive. But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses” (KJV) Mk 11:25-26. Christ is the standard of our forgiveness, Eph 4:32. The only way to keep malice off your heart is the way of instant forgiveness at the first acknowledge of the fault. By so doing you will be able to treat your offender kindly just as if he had never hurt or harmed you – as Christ treated you when He forgave your sins and trespasses.
confession: The Spirit of God is at work in me. I am endowed with grace to forgive and forbear.

title: : LOVE THAT FORBEARS, FORGIVES AND FELLOWSHIPS
verse: “. Love your enemies.” (KJV) Matt 5:44
body: : LOVE THAT FORBEARS, FORGIVES AND FELLOWSHIPS “. Love your enemies.” (KJV) Matt 5:44 An Armenian nurse’s brother was slain by a Turkish soldier right before her eyes. She somehow got escaped and later became a nurse in a military hospital. One day, the same man who had killed her brother was brought wounded to the hospital where she worked. Something within her cried out "Vengeance." But a stronger voice called for her to love - nursed the man back to health. The soldier asked her, "Why didn't you let me die?" She replied, "I am a follower of Him who said, 'Love your enemies.” Startled by her answer, the young soldier answered, "I never heard such words before. Tell me more. I want this kind of religion.” From our text, Christ made four categories of enmity clear: 1. Enemies can show his enmity in form of curse 2. Enmity could be in form of hatred 3. It could be in form of being despitefully used 4. It could also be in form of persecution. In all these, Christ expects us to face the act of curse with the act of blessing; the act of hatred with the act of good deed while the act of being despitefully used and persecution should be faced with prayer, Act 7:60 and Rom 12:20.
prayer: Pray fervently for His grace as led.

title: : LOVING EVEN YOUR ENEMIES
verse: “Defraud ye not one the other.” (KJV) 1 Cor 7:5
body: : LOVING EVEN YOUR ENEMIES “Defraud ye not one the other.” (KJV) 1 Cor 7:5 There is no greater blessing on earth than a good marriage. A young couple visited an older couple who was celebrating their 50th wedding anniversary. "Fifty years!" the young husband exclaimed, "That is a long time to be married to one person." The old man looked at his wife and said, "It would have been a lot longer without her." “Honor marriage, and guard the sacredness of sexual intimacy between wife and husband. God draws a firm line against casual and illicit sex” (TBCL). Sexual denial within marriage is against God’s standard, “Do not refuse one another except perhaps by agreement for a season, that you may devote yourselves to prayer; but then come together again, lest Satan tempt you through lack of self-control” of Heb. 13:4 (RSV). Sexual intimacy in marriage is to be enjoyed and not to be endured, “And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed” (KJV) Gen. 2:25. Sex worth waiting for, for the unmarried - the bed must be kept undefiled!
prayer: Father, I’m so sorry in every way I’ve got it wrong in my marriage. I promise You to keep to the standard of Your Word in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: LOVE, MARRIAGE AND SEXUAL RELA TIONSHIP
verse: “. rooted and grounded in love” (KJV) Eph 3:17
body: LOVE, MARRIAGE AND SEXUAL RELA TIONSHIP “. rooted and grounded in love” (KJV) Eph 3:17 From two different meta phorical words taken from the field of agriculture and architecture, Apostle Paul prayed, “May Christ through your faith [actually] dwell (settle down, abide, make His permanent home) in your hearts! May you be rooted deep in love and founded securely on love” (AMP). “I pray that Christ may make His home in your hearts through your faith; so that having your roots deep and your foundations strong, in love, you may become mighty to grasp the idea” (WNT). We need to be firmly established like a tree whose root goes deep into the soil and be firmly founded as a building on the rock. It’s not enough that Christ dwells in the head – that is in the realm of intellectual knowledge, the right dwelling place for Christ is the heart – that is in the realm of deepest inner feelings. Read Eph 2:20-22 and evaluate your love. The more sincere you’re in your personal appraisal, the better your personal growth becomes.
confession: I am advancing in love more and more. I am moving ahead in the practical demonstration of Christlike love. This is my goal – to be rooted and grounded in love.

title: : ROOTED AND GROUNDED
verse: “Now faith is.” (NKJV) Heb 11:1
body: : ROOTED AND GROUNDED “Now faith is.” (NKJV) Heb 11:1 As I thoughtfully look at our text, I see a delightful definition of faith: Faith is NOW. That's exactly what faith is! Faith is not in the future; it is in the present. Faith is prompt, instant and without hesitation. If your life must blossom, you have to learn the principle of immediacy of faith. It takes faith to fly. The word faith as used in our text is from Greek pistis denoting inner conviction of the truthfulness of God and total reliance on Christ. Faith is a deep-seated and unflinching confidence in God. “What is faith? It is the confident assurance that something we want is going to happen.” (TLB). Faith is believing in advance! “NOW FAITH is the assurance (the confirmation, the title deed) of the things [we] hope for, being the proof of things [we] do not see and the conviction of their reality [faith perceiving as real fact what is not revealed to the senses]” (AMP). Faith is not human sense, it’s bible sense! Faith is a confidence-based trust!
prayer: Dear Lord, I am fully loaded for a new realm of faith. I am asking for inner enablement to make my faith work promptly, instantly, and without hesitation in Jesus' name, Amen.
